title: Pick your @
summary: Lets the person pick or change their @ (username), with a live check that it is free. After sign-up it opens from the handle prompt card above the chat list; settings open the same screen later.

currentHandle.description: The @ the account has now, from GET /v1/me/handle. Absent for a new account.

nextChangeAt.description: From GET /v1/me/handle: before this time a change is refused (cooldown).

input.description: The field, without @, after BipeHandle sanitising (lower case, allowed characters only).

status.description: Local rule first (registries/handles.json), then GET /v1/handles/{handle}/availability, debounced. unchanged: input equals currentHandle.

error.description: String key of a save error: bipe_error_handle_cooldown, bipe_handle_taken, bipe_error_network or bipe_error_generic.

editHandle.effect: Sanitises the text, sets input, and starts the local check and then the availability check.

save.effect: Sends PUT /v1/me/handle. On 200 sets phase to saved, shows bipe_handle_saved and closes. Save is on only when status is available.

remove.effect: After a confirm dialog with bipe_handle_remove_body, sends DELETE /v1/me/handle and shows bipe_handle_remove_done. Only when currentHandle exists.

dismissPrompt.effect: From the prompt card: hides the card (registries/onboarding.json prompts.handle, trigger chatListWithoutHandle) and keeps it hidden on this phone.

notes: The handle rule (length, pattern, cooldown) is in registries/handles.json with cases in test-vectors/handles.json. bipe_handle_too_short and bipe_handle_too_long take minLength and maxLength.
Calls to bipe-api with auth send the Matrix access token from Client.session.
During the cooldown the field is read-only and the footer shows bipe_handle_cooldown_until with nextChangeAt from the system date formatter.

Bipe logic: BipeHandle.sanitize and localProblem, BipeHandleAvailabilityChecker, BipeAPIClient.setMyHandle and removeMyHandle (iOS); BipeHandle, BipeHandleAvailabilityChecker, BipeHandlePrompt, BipeApiClient.setMyHandle (Android).
The chat notices about a handle change (handle-change-notice) are not part of this screen.
